_doc: Panel of auction houses for the Invaluable tracker. kind: private_label (house site on Invaluable's platform; its own past-auctions pages link the hosted catalogs) | auctionzip (explicit catalog refs only; house pages are bot-challenged). past_list: the house page that links past sales. catalogs: optional { ref: 'auction-catalog/<slug>_<REF>' } seeds. Collection is permission-based; keep the client identified and polite (lib.mjs).

houses.name: Carroll's Auctioneers & Appraisers
houses._note: No private-label site; catalog refs come from the public Invaluable house page, data from the www.auctionzip.com gateway — which challenges our client until allowlisted. Enable once LQDT has allowlisted the tracker UA/IP.
